$comment: Curated intake for Transformer Tenders. build-tenders.js merges this file into data/tenders.json. Add a row only after the official portal is checked. See docs/tender-intake.md. Do not commit bid PDFs.

notices.title: CPRI Bengaluru automated transformer test bench
notices.summary: Central Power Research Institute in Bengaluru has an open GeM bid for one automated no-load, load-loss and temperature-rise test bench. The BidPlus notice is GEM/2026/B/8212405, dated 5 November 2026, and the bid end on that notice is 28 November 2026 at 11:00 India time. Delivery on the notice is to the CPRI office at Sadashivanagar, Bengaluru.

notices.title: POWERGRID Eastern Region-II CT analyzers
notices.buyer: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
notices.summary: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited has a bid for two current-transformer analyzers for Eastern Region-II. Bid GEM/2026/B/8222695 is dated 12 November 2026 and the bid end on the published notice is 27 November 2026 at 11:00 India time. The notice splits the two units between the Alipurduar HVDC station and the Berhampore switching station. POWERGRID published that bid on its own tender host.

notices.title: GSECL Sikka power transformer test kit
notices.summary: Gujarat State Electricity Corporation Limited has an open GeM bid for one 3-phase multi-function power transformer test kit for the Sikka thermal station. Bid GEM/2026/B/8235664 is dated 6 November 2026 and the bid end on the BidPlus notice is 27 November 2026 at 15:00 India time. The consignee address on the notice is Sikka Thermal Power Station, Jamnagar, and the quantity is one.
